API reference#

crowstacks.load_cartesian_catalog(path, pos_key='pos', extra_keys=None)#

Load a galaxy catalog with Cartesian positions from an npz file.

Reads an npz file and returns galaxy positions as a numpy array of shape (N, 3). Positions are assumed to be comoving coordinates in units of Mpc/h. Additional arrays (e.g. velocities, masses) can be requested by key and are returned in a dictionary.

Parameters:

  • path (str or Path) – Path to the npz file.

  • pos_key (str) – Key for the position array in the npz file. The array must have shape (N, 3). Defaults to "pos".

  • extra_keys (list of str, optional) – Keys of additional arrays to return, e.g. ["vel", "mass"]. Keys must match exactly. Defaults to None.

Returns:

A tuple (pos, extras) where

  • pos (np.ndarray, shape (N, 3)) – Comoving Cartesian positions in Mpc/h.

  • extras (dict) – Dictionary of additional arrays keyed by their npz key. Empty if extra_keys is None.

Return type:

tuple

Raises:

  • KeyError – If pos_key or any key in extra_keys is not found in the npz file. The error message lists all available keys.

  • ValueError – If the position array does not have shape (N, 3).

Examples

Load positions only:

>>> pos, _ = load_cartesian_catalog("catalog.npz")

Load positions and line-of-sight velocities:

>>> pos, extras = load_cartesian_catalog(
...     "catalog.npz",
...     pos_key="pos_g",
...     extra_keys=["v_los"]
... )
>>> v_los = extras["v_los"]
crowstacks.load_sky_catalog(path, ra_col='RA', dec_col='DEC', extra_cols=None)#

Load a galaxy catalog with sky coordinates from a FITS file.

Reads a FITS table and returns sky positions as numpy arrays. Additional columns (e.g. redshift, velocity, mass) can be requested by name and are returned in a dictionary.

Parameters:

  • path (str or Path) – Path to the FITS file.

  • ra_col (str) – Name of the right ascension column. Must be in degrees. Defaults to "RA".

  • dec_col (str) – Name of the declination column. Must be in degrees. Defaults to "DEC".

  • extra_cols (list of str, optional) – Names of additional columns to return, e.g. ["Z", "MASS"]. Column names must match exactly. Defaults to None.

Returns:

A tuple (ra, dec, extras) where

  • ra (np.ndarray, shape (N,)) – Right ascension in degrees.

  • dec (np.ndarray, shape (N,)) – Declination in degrees.

  • extras (dict) – Dictionary of additional columns keyed by column name. Empty if extra_cols is None.

Return type:

tuple

Raises:

ValueError – If ra_col, dec_col, or any column in extra_cols is not found in the file. The error message lists all available column names.

Examples

Load positions only:

>>> ra, dec, _ = load_sky_catalog("catalog.fits")

Load positions and redshift:

>>> ra, dec, extras = load_sky_catalog(
...     "catalog.fits",
...     ra_col="RA",
...     dec_col="DEC",
...     extra_cols=["Z"]
... )
>>> redshift = extras["Z"]
